event: Launches a Vine feed while attending Ohio University (exact start date not stated)
Registers his first YouTube channel, TheOfficialLoganPaul
Drops out of Ohio University and moves to Los Angeles to work in social media full time
Ranked the 10th most influential figure on Vine; six-second videos earn hundreds of thousands of dollars in ad revenue
Creates the Logan Paul Vlogs channel, later his main channel
9.3M Vine followers and 4B+ loops; says Vine has plateaued and he is looking beyond social media
Vine shuts down with Paul at roughly 9.4M followers (sources range 9.3M-9.47M)
Launches the Maverick clothing line; Forbes estimates at least $12.5M in 2017 earnings, 4th-highest-paid YouTuber
Logan Paul Vlogs reaches 10M subscribers in 333 days, the fastest in YouTube history per YouTube
Uploads a vlog filmed in Japan's Aokigahara forest that showed an apparent suicide victim; removed within about 24 hours after widespread criticism
Posts apologies, deletes the video and announces a break from YouTube
YouTube removes his channels from Google Preferred, puts YouTube Originals on hold and drops him from Foursome season 4; videos stay eligible for normal monetization
Ends daily vlogging at 17M subscribers; announces Impaulsive, a boxing match with KSI and a Twitch venture
Launches the Impaulsive podcast
Flobots sues over copyright infringement tied to his song 'No Handlebars'; he deletes the song from YouTube
Introduces the CryptoZoo NFT game (year inferred from 2025 coverage: 'over four years since')
Named to Forbes' highest-paid YouTube creators list (also 2017 and 2018)
Announces Prime Hydration with KSI on a livestream
Faces Roman Reigns at WWE Crown Jewel; tears his meniscus and MCL
Coffeezilla publishes a CryptoZoo investigation series
Prime becomes a UFC sponsor
Apologizes over the failure of CryptoZoo
Class-action lawsuit filed over CryptoZoo (allegations only; Paul denies wrongdoing)
Faces Seth Rollins at WrestleMania 39
Wins the WWE United States Championship
Announces a CryptoZoo buy-back using up to $2.3M of his own funds
Prime becomes WWE's Official Hydration Drink Partner with its logo in the center of the ring
Sues Stephen Findeisen (Coffeezilla) for defamation over CryptoZoo videos
Lunchly, a kid-oriented meal kit, is launched with Feastables and Prime
Impaulsive joins the WWE & Fanatics digital content network
Magistrate judge recommends that Paul not face the CryptoZoo class action as then pleaded
Plaintiffs file a Second Amended Complaint; Paul moves to dismiss on 2026-01-30
Appointed General Partner of venture firm Anti Fund, co-founded by Jake Paul
Announces a new long-term WWE contract and says he is officially a full-timer
WWE announces a torn triceps suffered at Saturday Night's Main Event; out for months
Coffeezilla defamation suit settled out of court and dismissed by Paul; terms undisclosed
Main channel at 23.6M subscribers with zero gained in the prior 28 days
